title: Stallholders
subtitle: Marketplace, craft and good things for camp.
intro_lead: Do you have goods, a craft, a service or a programme that fits the world of Middle-earth? Get in touch.
who_p1: This page is meant for stallholders, craftspeople, traders, makers, services and other partners who want to be part of The Lord of the Rings event.
who_p2_post: at the event, several days of camp life, a Friday side programme and the main game on Saturday. Well-chosen stalls can substantially boost the atmosphere of the whole event.
what_intro: We mostly welcome things that fit into the atmosphere of fantasy, camp, craft and adventure. Suitable types of stalls:
what_l9: thematic sales that fit the world of Middle-earth.
gastro_p1_pre: Food and drink stalls need to be arranged individually and in advance. We have an exclusive arrangement at the event with the
gastro_p1_post: , which provides an important part of the facilities, atmosphere and refreshments. We therefore always discuss any further food and drink stalls first among the organisers, and also with the Green Dragon inn.
gastro_alert: It does not automatically mean that further refreshments are not possible. It means they have to make sense operationally, in terms of capacity, and fairly with respect to our agreed partner.
h_60s: The most important things in 60 seconds
s60_l2: The main game is on Saturday; Friday is good for camp programme, meeting people and selling.
s60_l4: A stall must be arranged with the organisers in advance.
s60_l5: Food and drink stalls are handled individually due to the arrangement with the Green Dragon inn.
s60_l6: The look of the stall should fit into the atmosphere of the event.
s60_l7: Stallholders may take part in the game and activities at their own discretion.
s60_l8: Organisers do not provide oversight of the stall while the stallholder is away.
s60_l9: Respect camp rules, safety, quiet hours and organiser instructions.
h_play: Taking part in the game and programme
play_p1: Stallholders aren’t locked behind the counter. If they want, they can take part in the game, in camp life and in other activities at their own discretion.
play_alert_pre: When you leave the stall, that’s your decision.
play_alert_strong: We as organisers do not provide oversight or supervision of the stall while you’re away.
play_l3: clearly marking when the stall is open,
play_l4: considering whether you’re coming primarily to sell, to play, or both.
reg_intro: Stallholders can register according to how they want to take part:
reg_card1_p: Suitable if you mainly want to run the stall, be in camp, move around the area, but not take part in the main game as a fighter.
reg_card2_p: Suitable if you want to play normally alongside the stall, be part of an army and join the programme as a regular participant.
reg_note: If you’re not sure, write to us and we’ll work out which option suits you better.
h_we_you: What we provide and what you provide
we_l1: a place for the stall in the market / camp area,
exp_l1: A timely arrangement before the event.
exp_l2: A description of your goods or service.
exp_l3: Information on space, vehicle, electricity, water and facility needs.
exp_l5: Cleanliness and tidying of your space.
exp_l7: A look that doesn’t disturb the atmosphere of Middle-earth.
exp_note: Ideally a stall doesn’t look like a modern roadside selling stand, but as part of a camp, market or fantasy bazaar.
look_l1: wood, canvas, jute, ropes, leather, natural materials,
look_l5: evening lighting in a warm tone,
look_l6: no aggressive banners, reflective colours or strikingly modern advertising elements.
look_note: If you don’t have a thematic stall, that’s fine. Often a few tweaks and covering up the modern parts are enough.
practical_intro: Before the event we need to know:
practical_l7: whether you need to drive into the area by car,
practical_l8: whether you’ll be sleeping on site,
practical_l9: whether you want to take part in the game as a playing or non-playing participant,
practical_l10: whether you want to be listed on the website and social media.
present_p1_pre: On the website we have a page
present_p1_post: where we publish information about the stalls and vendors who will be at the event. We’re happy to put your information there too.
present_l2: a short description of what you offer,
present_l6: when you plan to be open.
legal_alert_post: Each stallholder is responsible for their own sales, permits, hygiene requirements, labelling, taxes and other legal obligations connected with their activity. The organiser sets the location of the stall and operational rules in the event area.
link4_post: — safety, camp, fire, movement on site.
cta_heading: Want to come as a stallholder?
cta_body_pre: Write to us with what you offer, how much space you need and whether you only want to be at the stall or also take part in the game. If it makes sense for the event and the atmosphere, we’ll be glad to include you. We’ll also be happy to introduce you on the
vendors_box_h: Which stalls will you find at PP this year?
vendors_box_body: Have a look at the list of registered vendors and their profiles.
